findings.explanation: HOL4 defines HD only by HD (h::t) = h. Defn.sml:1192 and Prim_rec.sml:281 make it a new_specification whose saved theorem has just that clause, so HD [] is open. ARB is a separate undefined constant (boolScript.sml:245), and no HOL4 theorem found relates the two. Lean's clause HD [] = ARB makes `HD [] = ARB` provable by rfl. It also proves `HD [] = THE none`, and so EL 0 [] = ARB. HOL4 cannot prove these equations. EL has the right clauses and only inherits this through HD.
findings.repair:
opaque HD_NIL (α : Type) [Nonempty α] : α

def HD [Nonempty α] : List α → α
  | h :: _ => h
  | [] => HD_NIL α
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.ListLib

theorem HD_nil_eq_ARB {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : CmlTS.HD ([] : List α) = CmlTS.ARB := by rfl

theorem HD_nil_eq_THE_none {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : CmlTS.HD ([] : List α) = CmlTS.THE (none : Option α) := by rfl
